title: Dermalogica Breakout Biotic Moisturiser Review: 0.5% Salicylic Acid Gel for Breakout-Prone Skin
description:
Dermalogica Breakout Biotic Moisturiser: a daily gel moisturizer with 0.5% salicylic acid for breakout-prone skin. What's in it, who it's for and how to use it.

We earn a commission if you buy through our link.

• Daily breakout-targeting gel moisturizer with a prebiotic blend
• Salicylic acid (0.5%) exfoliates dead skin cells to help keep pores clear
• Niacinamide and jojoba strengthen the barrier and reduce the look of pores and marks
• Manuka and magnolia extracts visibly reduce sebum
• After cleansing and toning, apply in light upward strokes; follow with SPF by day
